def _features(train, test):
    lab = np.r_[train['lab_id'], test['lab_id']]
    stratum = np.r_[train['stratum'], test['stratum']]
    raw = np.vstack((train['coupon_features_raw'], test['coupon_features_raw']))
    ref = np.vstack((train['ref_coupons'], test['ref_coupons']))
    x = np.empty_like(raw, dtype=float)
    for j in np.unique(lab):
        use = lab == j
        panel = ref[use]
        panel = panel[:, np.isfinite(panel).sum(axis=0) >= 2]
        shift = np.median(np.nanmean(panel, axis=0))
        scale = np.median(np.nanstd(panel, axis=0, ddof=0))
        x[use] = (raw[use] - shift) / scale
    missing = ~np.isfinite(x)
    _, cell, counts = np.unique(np.column_stack((lab, stratum)), axis=0, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    w = 1.0 / counts[cell]
    denom = (~missing).T @ w
    means = np.divide(np.where(missing, 0.0, x).T @ w, denom, out=np.zeros(x.shape[1]), where=denom > 0)
    return (np.column_stack((np.ones(len(x)), np.where(missing, means, x))), missing)

def _design(tau, past, hold, dt, t, x, yield_stress):
    trailing = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    kernel = np.exp(-trailing[:, None] / tau) * -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / tau)
    delta = hold[:, None] - past @ kernel
    relax = -np.expm1(-t[:, None] / tau)
    ov = np.maximum(0.0, abs(hold) - yield_stress) ** 2 * np.sign(hold)
    work = np.maximum(0.0, abs(past) - yield_stress) ** 2 @ dt * hold
    a = np.concatenate((delta[:, None, :] * relax, x[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None], ov[:, None, None] * t[None, :, None], work[:, None, None] * relax[None, :, :1]), axis=2)
    r = np.column_stack((delta / tau, x, ov, work / tau[0]))
    return (a, r)

def _fit(past, hold, dt, t, x, y, rate, yield_stress):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    cm, rm = (np.isfinite(y), np.isfinite(rate))
    yc, yr = (y[cm], rate[rm])
    obs = np.r_[yc, yr]
    active = np.any(_design(np.array([0.6, 2.0]), past, hold, dt, t, x, yield_stress)[1] != 0, axis=0)

    def matrix(tau):
        a, r = _design(tau, past, hold, dt, t, x, yield_stress)
        return np.vstack((a[cm], r[rm]))[:, active]
    scales = np.ones(len(obs)) * 0.035
    starts = []
    grid = (0.18, 0.32, 0.55, 0.9, 1.5, 2.5, 4.2, 7.0, 12.0)
    for i, u in enumerate(grid[:-1]):
        for v in grid[i + 1:]:
            mat = matrix(np.array([u, v]))
            theta = np.linalg.lstsq(mat, obs, rcond=None)[0]
            e = np.einsum('ij,j->i', mat, theta) - obs
            w = np.sqrt(np.minimum(1.0, max(0.006, 2.5 * np.median(abs(e))) / np.maximum(abs(e), 1e-12)))
            theta = np.linalg.lstsq(mat * w[:, None], obs * w, rcond=None)[0]
            e = np.einsum('ij,j->i', mat, theta) - obs
            starts.append((np.log1p((e / scales) ** 2).sum(), np.r_[np.array([np.log(u), np.log((v - u) / (24.9 - v))]), theta]))
    starts.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[0])

    def taus(p):
        u = np.exp(p[0])
        return np.array([u, u + (24.9 - u) / (1 + np.exp(-p[1]))])

    def residual(p):
        return (np.einsum('ij,j->i', matrix(taus(p)), p[2:]) - obs) / scales
    n = active.sum()
    bounds = (np.r_[[np.log(0.051), -12.0], np.full(n, -np.inf)], np.r_[[np.log(12.0), 12.0], np.full(n, np.inf)])

    def fit(p):
        return least_squares(residual, p, bounds=bounds, loss='cauchy', x_scale='jac', max_nfev=140)
    best = min((fit(p) for _, p in starts[:3]), key=lambda sol: sol.cost)
    e = residual(best.x) * scales
    for block in (slice(None, len(yc)), slice(len(yc), None)):
        z = e[block]
        if z.size:
            scales[block] = max(0.001, 2.5 * 1.4826 * np.median(abs(z - np.median(z))))
    best = fit(best.x)
    theta = np.zeros(9)
    theta[active] = best.x[2:]
    return (taus(best.x), theta)

def _refine_sparse(tr, checks, gain, bias, identified, tau, theta, dt, times, y):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    relax = -np.expm1(-times[:, None] / tau)
    trailing = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    kernel = np.exp(-trailing[:, None] / tau) * -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / tau)
    survival = np.exp(-dt.sum() / tau)
    modes = (relax - np.outer(times, times @ relax / (times @ times))) * theta[:2]
    for lab in np.flatnonzero(~identified):
        use = (tr['lab_id'] == lab) & np.isfinite(y).all(axis=1)
        if use.sum() < 4:
            continue
        curve = y[use]
        projected = curve - np.outer(curve @ times / (times @ times), times)
        command = tr['stress_hold_cmd'][use, None] - tr['past_stress_cmd'][use] @ kernel
        memory = tr['initial_memory_states'][use] * survival
        a = (command @ modes.T).ravel()
        b = survival @ modes.T
        mat = np.column_stack((a, np.tile(b, use.sum())))
        obs = (projected + memory @ modes.T).ravel()
        norm = np.linalg.norm(mat, axis=0)
        if norm[0] == 0:
            continue
        if norm[1] > 1e-08 * norm[0]:
            bfit = least_squares(lambda v: mat / norm @ v - obs, np.array([gain[lab], bias[lab]]) * norm, loss='soft_l1', f_scale=0.025).x / norm
        else:
            bfit = np.array([gain[lab], bias[lab]])
        x, z = _checks(checks, lab)
        if len(x):
            distance = np.abs(z - bfit[0] * x - bfit[1])
            k = distance.argmin()
            if distance[k] < 0.12:
                anchor_x, anchor_y = (x[k], z[k])
                column = mat[:, 0] - anchor_x * mat[:, 1]
                target = obs - anchor_y * mat[:, 1]
                fitted = least_squares(lambda v: column * v[0] - target, [bfit[0]], loss='soft_l1', f_scale=0.025).x[0]
                bfit = [fitted, anchor_y - anchor_x * fitted]
        if bfit[0] > 0:
            gain[lab], bias[lab] = bfit

def _refine_sparse_calibration(checks, gain, bias, identified, lab, cmd_past, cmd_hold, dt, t, x, y, rate, complete):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    source = complete & identified[lab]
    if source.sum() < 12:
        return
    known = lab[source]
    tau, theta = _fit(cmd_past[source] * gain[known, None] + bias[known, None], cmd_hold[source] * gain[known] + bias[known], dt, t, x[source], y[source], rate[source])
    check_lab, check_cmd, check_true = (np.asarray(checks[k]) for k in ('lab_id', 'cmd_stress', 'true_stress'))
    for j in np.flatnonzero(~identified):
        use = complete & (lab == j)
        if use.sum() < 4:
            continue
        m = (check_lab == j) & np.isfinite(check_cmd) & np.isfinite(check_true)
        anchor_cmd = np.median(check_cmd[m]) if m.any() else 0.0
        anchor_true = np.median(check_true[m]) if m.any() else 0.0
        past, hold = (cmd_past[use] - anchor_cmd, cmd_hold[use] - anchor_cmd)
        a, r = _design(tau, past, hold, dt, t, x[use])
        q, v = _design(tau, np.ones_like(past), np.ones_like(hold), dt, t, x[use])
        curve_base = (x[use] @ theta[2:])[:, None] * t + anchor_true * (q[:, :, :2] @ theta[:2])
        rate_base = x[use] @ theta[2:] + anchor_true * (v[:, :2] @ theta[:2])
        curve_target, rate_target = (y[use] - curve_base, rate[use] - rate_base)
        cm, rm = (np.isfinite(curve_target), np.isfinite(rate_target))
        target = np.r_[curve_target[cm], rate_target[rm]]
        design = np.r_[(a[:, :, :2] @ theta[:2])[cm], (r[:, :2] @ theta[:2])[rm]][:, None]
        if not m.any():
            design = np.column_stack((design, np.r_[(q[:, :, :2] @ theta[:2])[cm], (v[:, :2] @ theta[:2])[rm]]))
        if np.linalg.matrix_rank(design) < design.shape[1]:
            continue
        start = np.array([gain[j]]) if m.any() else np.array([gain[j], bias[j]])
        fit = least_squares(lambda p: design @ p - target, start, loss='cauchy', f_scale=0.02)
        if fit.success and fit.x[0] > 0:
            gain[j] = fit.x[0]
            bias[j] = anchor_true - gain[j] * anchor_cmd if m.any() else fit.x[1]

def solve_alpha_m96_w01_s00(dataset: dict) -> dict:
    train, test = (dataset['train'], dataset['test'])
    x, missing = _features(train, test)
    checks = dataset['calibration_load_cells']
    gain, bias, identified = _load_calibration(checks, return_identified=True)

    def stresses(split):
        lab = np.asarray(split['lab_id'])
        return (np.asarray(split['past_stress_cmd']) * gain[lab, None] + bias[lab, None], np.asarray(split['stress_hold_cmd']) * gain[lab] + bias[lab])
    dt, t = map(np.asarray, (dataset['past_dt'], dataset['eval_times']))
    n = len(train['lab_id'])
    complete = ~missing[:n].any(axis=1)
    keep = complete if complete.sum() >= 12 else np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
    y = np.asarray(train['strain_curves_obs']) - np.asarray(train['strain_0'])[:, None]
    rate_obs = np.asarray(train['instant_rate_obs'])
    if not identified.all():
        _refine_sparse_calibration(checks, gain, bias, identified, np.asarray(train['lab_id']), np.asarray(train['past_stress_cmd']), np.asarray(train['stress_hold_cmd']), dt, t, x[:n], y, rate_obs, complete)
    past, hold = stresses(train)
    tau, theta = _fit(past[keep], hold[keep], dt, t, x[:n][keep], y[keep], rate_obs[keep])
    past, hold = stresses(test)
    a, r = _design(tau, past, hold, dt, t, x[n:])
    curve = np.asarray(test['strain_0'])[:, None] + np.einsum('ntp,p->nt', a, theta)
    rate = r @ theta
    obs_rate = np.asarray(test['instant_rate_obs'])
    update = missing[n:].any(axis=1) & np.isfinite(obs_rate)
    curve[update] += (obs_rate[update] - rate[update])[:, None] * t
    rate[update] = obs_rate[update]
    return {'estimated_taus': tau, 'hereditary_weights': theta, 'viscoplastic_weights': np.zeros(2), 'predicted_strain': curve, 'initial_rate_pred': rate}
